task: Red Team Inquisitor #6 — Vatech Ez3D2009 CBCT Picasso DICOM Dissection, Implant Databases (NimplantDB & SurgicalKitDB), and Navigation Planning
completed_steps: Comprehensive study of Picasso Trio real patient scan (Barabash S.V., 54yo female, 400 slices, 512 MB): PixelSpacing 0.2 mm, SliceThickness 0.2 mm, Step -0.2 mm, FOV 160x160x80 mm.
Formulated and verified exact Hounsfield conversion: HU = Raw * 1.38392857142857 - 1720, Dynamic range -1720 to +4979.4 HU, Window W:4400, C:1300 (-900 to +3500 HU).
Verified Patient-LPS coordinates [80, -80, 80] to [80, -80, 0.2] mm, verified loader with real Barabash slices via realDicomVolumeLoader.ts and test_volume_builder.ts (100% test pass).
Reverse-engineered Jet 4.0 Access database C:\Ez3D2009\DBFile\NimplantDB.mdb: extracted all 35 companies, 181 product lines, and 3085 concrete implant fixture models.

Detailed top-8 implant manufacturers: Osstem (252 models), Straumann (187 models), Nobel Biocare (297 models), Dentium (84 models), MIS (73 models), Astra Tech (30 models), Zimmer (84 models), Ankylos (19 models).
Extracted and audited C:\Ez3D2009\DBFile\SurgicalKitDB.mdb (5736 mappings across 14 surgical guide kits: Straumann GS, Osstem OneGuide, NobelGuide, Dentis, Zimmer, Astra Facilitate, etc.).

Decoded surgical guide sleeve mathematics: D_inner, D_outer, H_sleeve, and vertical offset V_offset (9.0/10.5 mm for Osstem OneGuide, 2.0/4.0/6.0 mm for Straumann Guided), total drilling length L_drill = L_implant + V_offset.
Audited orthogonal reslicing mathematics: verified tangent T(s), normal N(s) = T(s) x Z, binormal B = (0, 0, 1) and trilinear voxel interpolation vs cbctCrossSectionResliceMath.ts.

Audited implant safety engine and catalog in dental-crm (implantSafetyEngine.ts, implantCatalog.ts): exposed synthetic 80-item catalog stub, exposed lack of buccal bone plate monitoring and OOM browser crash risk with 512 MB raw volume.

Provided production-ready TypeScript models (VatechRealImplantFixture, ComprehensiveImplantSafetyReport) and PostgreSQL schema (implant_companies, implant_products, implant_fixtures, surgical_kits, fixture_surgical_kit_mappings).
Formulated Streaming LOD (Mipmap) architecture (LOD 1 64 MB overview + LOD 0 7 MB active ROI subvolume) to prevent browser OOM crashes on solo doctor laptops.
findings: Vatech Picasso Trio produces 0.2 mm isometric dual-jaw volumes (800x800x400 voxels) with RescaleSlope 1.3839 and RescaleIntercept -1720.
NimplantDB.mdb contains 3,085 real implant fixtures across 35 brands; current dental-crm catalog only has ~80 synthetic items.
SurgicalKitDB.mdb maps 14 surgical guide kits with strict sleeve offsets (V_offset), completely absent from current web app.
Browser OOM risk is critical when loading 512 MB raw Uint16Array + WebGL textures; streaming LOD 64 MB overview solves this reliably.
